---
title: "Comparing monitoring events"
description: "Select comparable monitoring rounds and map modeled head differences without interpreting them as storage change."
output: rmarkdown::html_vignette
---

Before comparison, verify units, vertical datum, measurement reference,
water-bearing unit, screen-selection rule, and event timing. `ps_head_change()`
returns paired-well measured changes separately from the modeled B-minus-A
surface difference and accounts for changing membership. Modeled head change
is not storage, depletion, recharge, or volumetric change.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
change <- ps_head_change(event_a, event_b, pair_by="well_id",
                         event_a_time=t1, event_b_time=t2, method="TPS")
```
